definitions.cohort: cognitively normal scans (CDRTOT==0); scans with missing CDR or CDRTOT>0 are not evaluated
definitions.MAE_pooled: mean |pred-age| over all CN scans of the population (one scan = one unit)
definitions.MAE_fold_mean: unweighted mean of the 5 per-fold MAEs (the 'headline' value in V4 Table A is of this kind)
definitions.CI: 95% percentile bootstrap of the pooled value, resampling SUBJECTS (all scans of a subject together), 10^4 draws
definitions.R2: 1 - SSE/SST (predictive R2 about the mean chronological age), not squared Pearson r
definitions.raw: predicted_age, model output with no correction
definitions.corrected: brain_age = (pred - b)/a with a,b fitted on other-fold CN sessions only (cross-fitted)
